primary_goal.definition: Average daily visits to https://gnsresearchhub.vercel.app over a rolling 30-day period. Prefer unique visitors when provider data is available; otherwise use page sessions/visits consistently and label the limitation.

measurement_status.provider_checked: Live Vercel Web Analytics script and GA4 tag are provider-ready, but central visit export is unavailable in this runtime. This run also verifies the head-level window.va queue/bootstrap, the client-side growth_provider_ready health event, and destination link_utm_* context on clicked/copied share paths for first-event capture. Ranking/review metrics refreshed (weekly trend_items=14, watchlist_items=30) and regenerated top3 marketing drafts ['chrome-nail-powder', 'rhinestone-stud-earrings-6mm', 'lash-bond-and-seal'].
measurement_status.raw_result: measurement pending: GA4_PROPERTY_ID plus service-account reporting access or approved Vercel Analytics export/API is still required to calculate rolling 30-day visits and component funnels.
measurement_status.interpretation: Traffic progress cannot be claimed yet. Product/share freshness and destination-level UTM tracking improved, while visit totals remain unavailable until GA4 Data API or Vercel Analytics export access is connected. Improved source: all-window published trend item coverage 33→37 (+4) Improved source: published trend URL total 101→107 (+6)

north_star: Help BSS retail owners find practical, evidence-backed product insights often enough that the hub becomes a repeat visit destination.
growth_channels: A/B testing of landing and CTA copy

needs_user_permission_or_credentials.why: The GA4 tag is live, but this cron run cannot read GA4 reporting data without a GA4 property ID plus a service-account JSON/key mounted in env or another approved server-side access method. Needed to report rolling 30-day visits centrally.

Vercel deploy credentials are available for this repo, but Vercel Analytics reporting export/API access is still not connected. Need an approved Vercel Analytics export/API method or dashboard export to measure rolling 30-day visits and custom growth events.
A memorable domain improves trust, repeat visits, and shareability versus a vercel.app URL.
Actual X/Twitter posting requires xurl CLI availability and OAuth credentials configured outside the agent session; never paste secrets into chat.
Paid tests require explicit budget, platform, and stop-loss rules before execution.
Needed to read growth_engagement_summary, growth_section_view, growth_click, and share/copy events centrally and calculate rolling 30-day average daily visits toward 500/day.

reporting.daily_growth_director: Report current measured traffic if credentials exist; otherwise report tracking readiness, marketing actions, blockers, and next permission needed.
reporting.hourly_ai_operator: Keep improving product insight quality, SEO/shareability, tracking, experiments, and conversion paths while preserving source/evidence discipline.

vercel_web_analytics.measurement_note: Vercel dashboard measures visitors, page views, referrers, geography, devices, and custom events without cookies.

ga4.event_bridge: assets/growth.js sends growth_exposure, growth_section_view, growth_engagement_summary, growth_click, and growth_share_copy_result through gtag when available, including session_id, anonymous visitor_id, visit_count, is_returning_visitor, days_since_first_seen, first/current UTM attribution, and destination link_utm_* fields for clicked/copied share paths.

internal_growth_events.purpose: A/B variant, anonymous visitor lifecycle, first/current UTM persistence, session_id, section visibility, engagement summary, share/copy/click/source events, destination link_utm_* attribution, and provider fan-out to Vercel Analytics and GA4.

sns_strategy.role: Drive BSS-owner repeat visits with concise, evidence-backed weekly item insights and UTM-tagged links.
sns_strategy.posting_rule_summary: After xurl is installed/authenticated, auto-post only safe evidence-backed ranking links within limits; keep replies/DMs/paid ads approval-only.
